Standard Edition

● Main Game

　・1 Ant Bazaar Listing Slot

　・4 Body Types*

*Only 3 Body types are available at the start of each season.

About the Game

An endlessly replayable, roguelite survival action game from the world of LET IT DIE in which you scavenge SPLithium in the brutal depths of Hell Gate and fight to make it out alive, or rot into oblivion.

In this hellish environment, each exploration features randomized enemy placements and loot, making no two runs the same. Die, and lose not only the items you’re carrying, but even your own Body. 

Continue evolving your strategy to descend deeper into Hell Gate and return with items and equipment that you can use to craft weapons and armor that will strengthen you in your runs. 

■ EVERY BODY IS UNIQUE

Begin your descent into the depths of Hell Gate as one of Raiders, each with different skills. Experiment with each Raider’s unique playstyle, high-powered skill, and passive abilities as you obliterate all enemies who stand in your way.  

■ GET STRONGER WITH EVERY RUN

For Raider mastery, death is only the beginning. Every run accumulates Mastery Points that you can use to continuously enhance your Body. Utilize Mastery Switch with eight different Bodies to switch up your playstyle so that your enemies never know what’s coming. There are countless ways in which you can build your Body to suit the playstyle that best works for you. 

■ DESCEND INTO HELL GATE WITH A FRIEND

Team up with a friend and descend into the depths of Hell Gate, an apocalyptic chasm teeming with monstrous creatures known as Yuckies and hostile Yotsuyama forces who will come at you without end.

Watch each other's backs, and your chances of survival will rise dramatically.

The Raiders Association looks forward to your return—with pockets full of SPLithium.

■ CRUSH DOWN ENEMIES, YOUR WAY

  • Weapons and armor come with randomized traits that create endless possibilities for buffs and attacks, making each find a unique, once-in-a-lifetime discovery. 

  • “Death Jamboree” returns from DEATHVERSE: LET IT DIE in a new form! For those who love competitive play, we recommend this PvP mode.

■ TAKE ON THE REAPER’S CHALLENGE

Having finally recovered from the unprecedented destruction of Earth Rage, humanity was once again struck by a terrifying new menace. A giant chasm, large enough to swallow an entire city, suddenly opened up in the ground one day.

How deep was it? What did it lead to? No one knew. Those who ventured to investigate all perished, and it became known as the dreaded “Hell Gate.”

Common sense should have kept everyone away. But the discovery of a rare and valuable resource inside, along with the pull of a mysterious rumor, drove people to madness.

“Deep within the Hole lies the Eye of the Reaper, a mass of SPLithium so large that whoever claims it could rule the world.”

To find it, one would have to jump into the abyss and overcome unimaginable difficulties. To fight through nightmarish hybrid monsters, unsettling hostile environments, and humans consumed by greed.

“Kill anyone who gets in the way”

The Yotsuyama Group: a megacorporation who will stop at nothing in its cruelty and evil. Hell on earth, hell in the Hole. Your only safe haven? Iron Perch, a floating base in the sky.

But don’t be afraid.

You’re a Raider—an immortal adventurer.

You can die and come back as many times as you want, switch Bodies, and race down a path of carnage! Take a death-defying dive into Hell from your base at an altitude of 30,000 feet.

To become immortal, you will need to abandon your past and sever all ties.

But don’t worry, you’re not alone. The coolest and wildest bunch there is is waiting for you at the Raiders Association!

A tearful receptionist in mourning clothes, a badass one-armed older woman, a mysterious mask-wearing veteran, a storyteller gone rogue, a proud and beautiful Raider... and many more for you to meet!

Fearless adventurer, the depths of the world call to you.

Take on the Reaper’s challenge and seize your future from the bottom of Hell!

■ DEATH IS NEVER THE END

Uncle Death challenges you to reach the deepest part of Hell Gate and collect a mysterious super-energy. This is both a mission and a trial.

The trial has a set time limit, and when it expires, the entire world undergoes reincarnation. In other words, it resets. Each new world may bring unseen equipment, enemies, and fields.

In this game, each new season marks a full restart. Your story progress, Raider Rank, inventory, and masteries will all be reset. However, Death Metal, any elements purchased with Death Metal, and most edition bonuses (such as Body types and decorations) will not be reset.

Keep exploring the ever-reincarnating Hell Gate that presents endless possibilities with each run.

data.short_description: Hell Gate tore open the earth! Deep within its chaotic depths, where time and space warp, lies the "Eye of the Reaper"—a treasure granting world-ruling power. You are an immortal Raider. Descend into the abyss, conquer the Reaper's challenge, and seize your future from the bottom of Hell!
